name: Spreadshirt Public Shop API
description: The Spreadshirt Public Shop API enables developers to build custom e-commerce applications on the Spreadshirt print-on-demand platform. It provides access to shop configuration, sellable products, product types, baskets, and promotions across European and North American platforms.
